title: capture() refuses a signal already aborted before it makes a window
why: The check dropped: a quit's abort that lands before the capture starts still gets an offscreen window.

replace:
const page = new ElectronCapturePage(job)
  if (options.signal?.aborted) throw new CaptureError('the capture was cancelled', true)
title: capture() refuses a signal already aborted before it makes a window
why: The check after the window is made: the window exists, if briefly, for a run already cancelled.
